actual_scope: One day of P104 research (Nov 14) on the decoder wall and the t = -1 park, organised around one cost, the odd unit paid per grading sigma_p: (I) proved lemmas with exact checks - o(N) = rank Odd(N) for any block/ring/coupling, the Cayley form (t = -1 iff the sigma-even part is singular), per-grading ledgers, t_eff = ab/(cd-ab) and M45 as the t = -1/2 B-port contract, the no-cloning family (Rank, Lock, Clone, Theorem W, NT, AS/VA, lift law, Freeze, shared lift <= 8, Commutation, XRECALL, Zone, owned additivity, wiring, the web-general Cut Lemma), decoder structure (UP+DOWN forced, G/2 = 13 proj, -12 I composition, joint rank >= 8k), decoder-wall pieces since #7583 (Lemma A(acyc), Lemma B mod-4, HALF18 rank-15/13 certificates, early-set cap), and local re-solve laws (Theorem F, LIN, TR, 2B, Descent, RT); (II) every route closed that day as a scoped negative result with its reason and numbers; (III) the words built that did not pay, replayed exactly against #7546 with their prices.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a constructive helper-basis or causal-split improvement. This package instead records lower bounds, scoped negative results and unpaid words on P104 so that others can see which decoder, t = -1, contract, multi-call and local-edit routes are closed and why; it makes no kappa claim and ships no new frontier word.
bottleneck_link: The P104 invoice's owned decoder mass (56 per plane) and the t = -1 park are the two fixed costs every proposed redesign has hit; this package shows they are one cost (the odd unit per grading) and that every construction tested pays about one owned unit per port per call, against a break-even near 0.214.
stop_rule: Every proved claim has a proof in PROOF.md; every finite fact quoted as [C] is re-run by a standard-library checker with positive and negative controls; lane-only numbers are tagged [C-lane] or [C-param]; open items stated as open; validator PASS.
